meta.name: Slow Horses
meta.description:
Follow a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents—and their obnoxious boss, the notorious Jackson Lamb—as they navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend England from sinister forces.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 1 Apr 2022 · United Kingdom, United States of America · Language: English
Studio: See-Saw Films, Flying Studio Pictures, Sony Pictures Television · Network: Apple TV

Not complete. On your server: S1 6/6 | S2 6/6 | S3 6/6 | S4 6/6 | S5 6/6 | S6 not on server

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Failure's Contagious
videos.overview: River Cartwright is ousted from MI5 and finds himself in a place worse than purgatory: Slough House, dumping ground for failed spies.

videos.title: Work Drinks
videos.overview: River and Sid join forces. A misfired gun has dire consequences.

videos.title: Bad Tradecraft
videos.overview: Slough House is the unlikely venue for a secret romance, but events take a dark turn when a dangerous encounter becomes deadly.

videos.title: Visiting Hours
videos.overview: Taverner sends the Dogs to hunt down Lamb and the Slow Horses. River holds the secret to saving the gang.

videos.title: Fiasco
videos.overview: The Slow Horses must disappear to avoid capture by MI5. Lamb and River head to The Park to outwit Taverner.

videos.title: Follies
videos.overview: Taverner and the Slow Horses attempt different approaches to locate the kidnappers and Hassan. Ho makes a shocking discovery about Sid.

videos.title: Last Stop
videos.overview: Jackson Lamb is on high alert after a former spy is found dead. Min and Louisa are tempted by an offer from outside Slough House.

videos.title: From Upshott with Love
videos.overview: Lamb liaises with a Russian defector who may hold a clue to sleeper agents. River is on the trail of a ruthless assassin.

videos.title: Drinking Games
videos.overview: River gets cozy in the Cotswolds while searching for a sleeper agent. Min discovers Russian drinking games are the most brutal of all.

videos.title: Cicada
videos.overview: Louisa makes her move on Pashkin. Catherine makes moves of a different kind when she plays high-stakes chess with a sinister stranger.

videos.title: Boardroom Politics
videos.overview: Lamb orders his Slow Horses to walk into traps. River believes something alarming is heading toward London.

videos.title: Old Scores
videos.overview: Lamb and Katinsky go head-to-head. Ho finds himself trapped on a train with a Russian assassin.

videos.title: Strange Games
videos.overview: A romantic relationship in Istanbul ends badly. Lamb hits the panic button when one of his Slow Horses fails to show up for work.

videos.title: Hard Lessons
videos.overview: River has to steal something out of the Park to save a life. Lamb realizes a stranger game is afoot.

videos.title: Negotiating with Tigers
videos.overview: Marcus and Shirley face Lamb's wrath. River discovers revenge is a dish best served cold.

videos.title: Uninvited Guests
videos.overview: Tearney makes a bold move. The Slow Horses assist the Tiger Team, unaware of their hidden agenda. Lamb and Ho take a road trip.

videos.title: Cleaning Up
videos.overview: Taverner and Tearney face off for control of MI5. River and Louisa find themselves caught in the crossfire.

videos.title: Footprints
videos.overview: The Slow Horses fight for their lives. Lamb shares some devastating truths with Catherine.

videos.title: Identity Theft
videos.overview: A London bombing puts Taverner under pressure. When River grows concerned for his grandfather, Louisa encourages him to go for a visit.

videos.title: A Stranger Comes to Town
videos.overview: A naive agent makes a discovery about the Westacres bomber. Lamb suspects that David knows more than he's letting on.

videos.title: Penny for Your Thoughts
videos.overview: River is trapped in France. Back at Slough House, the Dogs have come for Lamb.

videos.title: Returns
videos.overview: Taverner is desperate to hide dangerous secrets. River seeks answers at his grandfather's house.

videos.title: Grave Danger
videos.overview: Lamb questions David about France as River comes face to face with the enemy.

videos.title: Hello Goodbye
videos.overview: Impossible decisions are faced and sacrifices are made.

videos.title: Bad Dates
videos.overview: A mass shooting rocks London, intensifying a testy mayoral race. Shirley believes one of the Slow Horses was the target of an attempted hit.

videos.title: Incommunicado
videos.overview: Lamb intercepts an assassin. Taverner receives a key piece of intel about the Abbotsfield shooting.

videos.title: Tall Tales
videos.overview: An act of sabotage grinds London to a halt. Taverner interrogates Roddy. Coe is convinced a destabilization strategy is at play.

videos.title: Missiles
videos.overview: Flyte sets out to find Roddy's girlfriend. The gang is dispatched to two different campaign events to prevent another attack.

videos.title: Circus
videos.overview: Lamb debriefs River and Coe. Roddy is pulled in to help decipher a piece of code as the destabilization strategy nears its final stage.

videos.title: Scars
videos.overview: It's up to the Slow Horses to stop Farouk's team from completing its mission in a final act of mass carnage.

meta.slogan: MI5's most unruly spies are back and under attack.
